full_prompt_en: A square naive-style painting fills the frame with a colorful village landscape, its small houses, rounded trees, patterned hills, and narrow water band stacked in shallow layers. Across the upper edge, a dark blue sky carries repeated cream-and-rust cloud clusters, and a small yellow sun inside an orange ring hangs near the center. Below it, zigzag mountain ridges in plum, ochre, and muted teal cross the distance. The upper middle contains clusters of cream houses with red roofs, tucked among geometric green and blue slopes. A broad dark tree with tiny yellow marks anchors the upper left, while a rounded blue-green form dotted with orange circles fills the upper right. The middle ground becomes increasingly crowded with pale village walls, cypress-like dark uprights, flowering patches, and softly rounded shrubs. On the right, a large pale blossoming crown rises above a brown trunk; to the left, smaller rust and rose-colored crowns overlap dense patterned greenery. Near the lower center, a small cream building with a red roof stands before a gold-and-teal patterned mound. A horizontal teal water strip crosses the foreground, and a red boundary line closes the lower left edge. Many shapes are outlined simply and filled with repetitive dashes, dots, tiny leaves, and decorative grids, giving every area a handmade fabric-like surface. Space is organized by overlap and scale more than realistic perspective; distant structures remain sharply present instead of fading away. Flat bright light spreads across the scene, with little cast shadow, so color contrast and texture distinguish layers. Warm oranges, reds, and yellows pulse against cool teal and deep blue. The overall composition is exuberant and orderly at once, crowding small motifs into a clear sequence from dark foreground through village layers to the ringed sky.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形稚拙风格绘画用多彩村庄风景填满画面，小房屋、圆润树冠、带纹样的山坡和窄窄水带叠成浅浅的层次。上边缘横着深蓝天空，反复出现奶油白与锈色的云团，中央附近悬着一轮被橙色圆环包围的黄色小太阳。其下，梅紫、赭黄和柔和青绿的锯齿形山脊横贯远处。上方中部聚着奶油色房屋和红屋顶，藏在几何化的绿色与蓝色坡面之间。左上方一棵宽阔深色树冠缀着黄色细点，右上方则有一团点着橙色圆点的蓝绿色圆形体。中景愈加拥挤，浅色村舍墙面、深色柏树般的竖影、花团和圆润灌木密集交织。右侧大朵浅色花冠在棕色树干上升起；左侧较小的锈色和玫红树冠与繁密绿意重叠。下方中央附近，一栋红顶奶油色小屋立在金色与青绿纹样山丘前。横向青绿色水带穿过前景，一条红色边线收住左下边缘。许多形状由简单轮廓圈定，再填入重复的短线、圆点、小叶片和装饰网格，让每一处都像手工织物。空间主要通过重叠和尺度而非真实透视组织；远处结构仍然清晰存在，并不退成模糊影子。平而明亮的光铺满场景，投影很少，色彩反差与肌理因而区分层次。暖橙、红和黄在冷青绿与深蓝之间跳动。整体构图既热闹又有秩序，把小型纹样从深色前景、层层村舍一直推向环日天空。
style_prompt_en: A hand-painted naive treatment fills nearly every color area with small repeated marks while keeping the silhouettes blunt and readable. Saturated teal and deep blue form a cool foundation for warm russet, golden yellow, plum, and pale cream accents. Outlines are simple and slightly uneven, and interior surfaces carry dots, dashes, leaf-like strokes, and small geometric grids. Flat illumination minimizes modeled shadow; depth comes from overlapping bands, changes in scale, and alternating warm and cool patches. Rounded masses balance zigzag rhythms, and dense detail is distributed throughout rather than confined to a single focal point. A few strong horizontal divisions keep the crowded square coherent. The overall effect is decorative, tactile, exuberant, and deliberately unpolished.
style_prompt_zh: 手绘稚拙表现几乎把每片色域都填满重复小笔痕，同时保持外轮廓敦实而易辨。饱和青绿与深蓝构成冷色基础，衬托赤褐、金黄、梅紫和浅奶油色强调。轮廓简单且略不齐整，形体内部铺着圆点、短线、叶形笔触和细小几何网格。平坦照明使塑形阴影很少；纵深来自重叠色带、尺度变化及冷暖斑块交替。圆润体量与锯齿节奏平衡，繁密细节分布于各处，而非只聚在一个焦点。少数强烈的水平分界让拥挤的方形画面维持整体性。效果装饰性强、可触、欢快而有意保留粗朴感。
theme_en: A densely patterned village landscape beneath a ringed sun
theme_zh: 环形太阳下纹样密布的村庄风景
name: Naive art
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
